title: ICAN — 'NPT Review Conference ends with no plan for disarmament'
snippet: ICAN analysis: The 11th Review Conference concluded without adopting a final document. Nuclear-armed states fiercely resisted disarmament efforts. They blocked previously agreed language on humanitarian consequences of nuclear weapons. Russia tested Sarmat ICBM and US tested Minuteman ICBM during the conference period. UN Scientific Panel on 'Nuclear war effects' reference was blocked.
